configuration: default configuration (no custom vocabulary, keyterms or context prompt; Spanish selected where the system allows it; instruction-following models get only the fixed transcription instruction they need) for every system except the results-only ones. This covers the systems run with this package and the open-weights rows without a runner (runner null), which Omniloy ran outside the package on the same audio, with the same scoring and the settings given in each row. Results-only systems were evaluated by their owner under the conditions given in their note.

metrics.wer: word error rate, (S + D + I) / reference words, on normalized text
metrics.term_recall: clinical only: share of the gold medical terms of the reference found in full in the hypothesis (every word of the term correct)
metrics.bwer: clinical only: B-WER (Le et al., 2021), the error rate on the reference words that belong to gold medical terms
metrics.uwer: clinical only: U-WER, the error rate on every other reference word
metrics.degenerate_rate: share of clips whose output is empty, loops, or runs away

systems.label: OmniScribe 2 (Omniloy, self-hosted, not publicly available)
systems.settings: Omniloy's self-hosted clinical transcription system
systems.note: Evaluated by Omniloy; not runnable with this package. OmniScribe 2 uses context from the patient's record. In this test that context included the medical terms spoken in each clinical clip, so its clinical numbers are a best case. It transcribed whole clips offline. Its real-speech rows used no context and are given rounded, without intervals.
